name: benchmark_v1
WARNING: SYNTHETIC INJECTION on real base tickets. Injected symptoms are caught by construction; read the share of failures with no symptom and the natural flag rates instead.
base: 1,000 real closed Mumbai tickets (exact location), seed 7
dropped_symptom: batch_close: normal in real Mumbai data (see natural_flag_rates_real_data), so it is neither injected nor detected

failures_with_no_symptom.meaning: closed with no observable metadata symptom: only independent evidence (satellite, photo content, citizen, human) can catch these

fast_close_under_10_min.reading: rare, so a closure within 10 minutes of filing is a usable (weak) symptom

same_officer_same_minute_clusters.reading: NORMAL in this data, even across kilometres (bulk or desk closing): batch closing carries no signal and is NOT used.

natural_flag_rates_real_data.note: photo_reuse and wrong_location cannot be measured on real data: it has no photos or photo GPS.

pending: Agent cost-versus-accuracy ('run everything' vs the budgeted agent) needs Ayush's real verifiers; photo content checks need the demo photo set.
